#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

class ModInt {
public:
    int modulo;

    ModInt(int m) : modulo(m) {}

    int add(int x, int y) {
        x += y;
        if (x >= modulo) x -= modulo;
        return x;
    }

    int multiply(int x, int y) {
        return (int) ((long long)x * y % modulo);
    }
};

class E2AbnormalPermutationPairsHardVersion {
public:
    ModInt mod;

    void solve(int testNumber, int n, int m, int& answer) {
        mod = ModInt(m);
        vector<int> factorial(n + 1);
        factorial[0] = n;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            factorial[i] = mod.multiply(factorial[i - 1], n - i);
        }

        int maxPairs = n * (n - 1);
        vector<int> dp(maxPairs + 1, 0);
        int middle = maxPairs / 2;
        vector<int> temp(maxPairs + 1, 0);
        dp[middle] = 1;
        answer = 0;

        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int c = n - 1 - i;
            temp = dp;
            fill(dp.begin(), dp.end(), 0);
            int limit = (c * (c - 1)) / 2;
            int count = 0;

            for (int cur = -c; cur < 0; cur++) {
                int pairs = c + cur + 1;
                for (int j = middle - cur + 1; j <= middle + limit; j++) {
                    count = mod.add(count, mod.multiply(temp[j], pairs));
                }
            }

            int factVal = (i == 0) ? 1 : factorial[i - 1];
            answer = mod.add(answer, mod.multiply(count, factVal));

            for (int j = middle - limit; j <= middle + limit; j++) {
                for (int cur = -c; cur <= c; cur++) {
                    int pairs = c - abs(cur) + 1;
                    if (j + cur >= 0 && j + cur <= maxPairs) {
                        dp[j + cur] = mod.add(dp[j + cur], mod.multiply(pairs, temp[j]));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    E2AbnormalPermutationPairsHardVersion solver;
    int answer;
    solver.solve(1, n, m, answer);

    cout << answer << endl;

    return 0;
}
